business_problem: South Korean startup Wrtn Technologies is transforming everyday life with its AI "superapp," designed to enhance productivity, entertainment, and emotional connections.
solution_summary: Wrtn used Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Dynamics 365 to surface grounded answers from enterprise knowledge faster. South Korean startup Wrtn Technologies is transforming everyday life with its AI "superapp," designed to enhance productivity, entertainment, and emotional connections. Key implementation elements included Azure OpenAI Service generates natural-language responses and task automation for the solution; Azure AI Foundry supports model orchestration, evaluation, and governed deployment of the AI workflow; Microsoft Dynamics 365 provides the common business process layer that standardizes operations; Microsoft Azure hosts the application, data, and integrations on scalable cloud infrastructure. Enterprise content from documents, meetings, websites, or internal systems is passed through retrieval and model services so users receive grounded answers inside the target workflow.
